title: The Fourth, 2020
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: No fireworks. Cancelled. Gully sets off one on the dock anyway, illegal, white. The strip draws it in color: white.

panels.composition: The dock, night, no crowd. GULLY, MARIA in the chair, the kids, WOOD on the steps with BARNABY II. The sky empty. A sign on the shack: NO FIREWORKS 2020.

image.prompt: a wooden dock at night with only one family and a man with a dog, an empty sky, a hand-lettered sign on a shingle shack reading NO FIREWORKS 2020, clean ink with a blue wash

panels.composition: Gully at the dock's end with a single firework, a lighter, and a look at Maria. Maria's tiny nod: one.

characters.pose: with a firework and a lighter

image.prompt: a stocky man at the end of a dock holding one firework and a lighter, glancing at a woman in a lawn chair who gives a tiny nod

panels.composition: The one firework. White. The whole family's faces up. The pup barking at it. The strip gives it a full panel.

image.prompt: a single white firework bursting over a dark bay above a small family on a dock with their faces turned up and a dog barking, clean ink, no words

panels.composition: After. The smoke. The dark. Gully sitting on the steps. Wood. The chair. The one burst was the whole show and it was enough.

image.prompt: a dark dock after a single firework with smoke drifting, two men on shack steps, a dog, a woman in a lawn chair, quiet

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: One firework. 'White in mine too, tonight.' The last Fourth of the public strip.
